scenes.narration: You think Amazon makes its money selling you stuff? Not really.
Amazon Web Services, its cloud business, was only 18 percent of Amazon's sales in 2025, but it made 57 percent of its operating profit.
That's 45.6 billion dollars, from renting computer power to businesses and AI companies.
The warehouses and delivery vans are huge, but they run on much thinner margins.
So the boxes on your doorstep get the attention, but the servers pay the bills. Follow for more.
